source-audit/reference-review.json.scope: Independent source/formula review; no reference import or execution. Runner and final frozen plan remain pending.

checks.name: independence
checks.finding: Reference imports numpy only; production geometry, frames, residual, inertia and force functions are not called.

checks.name: geometry
checks.finding: Q=exp(h*k)Q0 rotates fin physical endpoints, stations and c/s/n consistently; span interval lengths/material stations are retained. Wind-directed a/b/hv/cp are reconstructed at each pose with current span denominators.

checks.name: collinear topology
checks.finding: For this constant-section straight-beam fixture, hv and every bound segment share one exact line; other same-beam segments are dropped only after ordered material-interval exclusion. Own bound omission applies hv/axis, CP keeps all bounds, wakes remain.

checks.name: quadrature
checks.finding: Finite and semi-infinite line contributions use normalized line tangent and theta substitution with q² including the declared cross-beam source core. No near-zero epsilon floor is introduced.

checks.name: finite base
checks.finding: Independent Gamma solves W*Gamma=-U*ncp.x; loaded hv/axis velocities and perpendicular speed are retained. Base force includes profile drag, material quarter-chord lift moment and nonzero local-Mach section couple.

checks.name: motion forcing
checks.finding: Bq includes rotating normal dot loaded CP velocity and moving-field term. Bv subtracts the prescribed angular velocity at wind-aligned CP. Circulation acceleration forcing is zero.

checks.name: lag sign
checks.finding: (W-lambda*D) Gammahat=-(Bq+lambda*Bv); D uses actual base perpendicular speed and is zero with lag off.

checks.name: perpendicular derivative
checks.finding: dVp=dV-(dV dot s+V dot ds)*s-(V dot s)*ds, including both rotating projection factors.

checks.name: circulation loads
checks.finding: All Gammahat, Gamma0-induced, moving-field, local-velocity and rotating-span lift derivatives are present; rate-lift uses lambda Gammahat and base perpendicular speed only.

checks.name: profile drag
checks.finding: Cdf uses complete velocity/speed while Cdp uses span-perpendicular velocity/speed. Squared-tangency pressure has zero first variation at the independently closed base.

checks.name: nonzero Cm
checks.finding: Cm/sqrt(1-(S/SOUND)^2) is retained even at PG Mach0; derivative scalar*(2/S+S/(SOUND²-S²))*dS and scalar*ds include magnitude and span-direction changes.

checks.name: moment arms
checks.finding: Moving lift arm differentiates both physical axis position and material chord; moving drag arm uses the beam axis. No profile force is incorrectly assigned the quarter-chord arm.

checks.name: apparent force
checks.finding: tau=lambda*(Va0 cross k) dot n; midpoint acceleration=lambda²*k cross(rmid-pivot); force=ma*(tau-a_mid dot n)*n. Rates/accelerations vanish on the wing.

checks.name: apparent couple
checks.finding: Intrinsic -ma*(chord/4*tau+chord²/32*lambda²*k dot s)*s plus midpoint force moment matches full 3D Eqs41-44. Base apparent loads are zero, so no omitted direction derivative is active.

checks.name: induced axis field
checks.finding: Ha is required only at base for this zero-rate operating state; its shape/Gamma derivatives multiply zero base angular rate. Own-bound exclusion follows declared source convention.

checks.name: scope
checks.finding: Reference matches the declared current wind-projected angular receiver convention. It does not establish that convention as uniquely required by all primary descriptions, nor establish mesh convergence or aircraft/experimental parity.

limitations: Source review does not replace actual numerical checks.

checks.finding: All117 current frozen pins verified; exact final runner/plan SHA bound.

checks.name: source continuity
checks.finding: All108 isolated production modules byte-equal ROOT and public kernel; runtime asserts module origins, plus exact independent reference origin.

checks.name: prelaunch timing
checks.finding: No results directory or execution record exists at this review.

checks.name: finite base geometry
checks.finding: Independent scipy versus Rodrigues rotations agree in declared order Ry7 Rz5; physical endpoints, midpoint, span and material frames compared before evaluation.

checks.name: endpoint geometry
checks.finding: All current fin midpoint and endpoint frames rotate with geometry; frame0 and frame1 are explicitly saved. Rigid transformation preserves material stations and lengths.

checks.name: motion
checks.finding: Body-relative velocity, angular rate, angular acceleration and centripetal acceleration follow the current fin positions about the fixed pivot. Wing motion stays zero.

checks.name: moment extraction
checks.finding: outputs() uses current rotated chord vectors for rate-lift quarter-chord arms and actual strip couples for total/apparent loads, followed by per-beam/net summation.

checks.name: material incidence
checks.finding: Section alpha stays2degrees; geometry rotation affects c/s/n independently, with no flight-angle replacement during local fin probes.

checks.name: sound speed
checks.finding: Explicit altitude0 plus equality of actual atmosphere/lifting sound speed, literalConstant, referenceSOUND and340.294; nonzero local-Mach Cm correction retained.

checks.name: complete base
checks.finding: Independent finite Gamma, production raw residual, force-point velocities, perpendicular speeds, positive profile force and nonzero corrected Cm plus all six base-wrench channels guarded.

checks.name: Gamma stencils
checks.finding: Complete centered J and Q, including lag-off exact zero behavior, remain checked against independent W/U and -D/U.

checks.name: motion stencils
checks.finding: Centered h,hdot,hddot columns at two widths keep rotation of geometry and normal, negative angular velocity forcing and zero direct acceleration in tangency.

checks.name: complex probes
checks.finding: Real/imag physical probes use h=1,hdot=iomega,hddot=-omega² with Gamma/Gamma_dot consistently perturbed, at both widths; raw results saved before comparison.

checks.name: all channels
checks.finding: Pointwise complex Gamma and total/rate/apparent/remainder wing,fin,net six-wrenches compare at original2e-8 absolute+relative gates.

checks.name: reference tightening
checks.finding: Two quadrature degrees and two angular probe widths compared independently; reference axis operator included at base, and no new moving-axis derivative needed at zero base rates.
